title: WRR window idles a skip-only lane's budget: a lane whose packets all forwarded this tick is 'ready' but unservable, so its WFQ share never flows to waiting lanes (gap-fill claim contradicted)
evidence: core/flow.odin: `+// bundle_lane_ready — which lanes of a bundle have queued packets this tick` / `+bundle_lane_ready :: proc(state: ^Run_State, cat: ^Catalogs, bi: u32) -> (ready: [LANE_COUNT]bool) {` / `+\t\tready[bundle_lane_of(state, cat, p)] = true` (no `forwarded`/skip exclusion) and `+\t\tif joined_this_tick {` / `+\t\t\tcontinue // forwarded this tick — consumes bandwidth from NEXT tick` and `+\t\tfor {` / `+\t\t\tready := bundle_lane_ready(state, cat, bi)` / `+\t\t\tbudget := qos_serialize(caps, ready, remaining)` / `+\t\t\t\twindow_served += serve_bundle_lane(state, cat, tick, bi, u8(lane), budget[lane], forwarded[:])` / `+\t\t\tif window_served == 0 {` / `+\t\t\t\tbreak // nothing ready / nothing served — drained or degenerate` / `+\t\t\tremaining -= window_served`; core/qos.odin: `+// packets is skipped (its entitlement flows to the next READY lane in the` / `+// walk — work-conserving gap-fill, the pipe is never idle while a packet` / `+// waits); a ready lane whose allocation is zero is floored to a 1-unit`
detail: bundle_lane_ready marks a lane ready by queue membership (joiners included); qos_serialize reserves its full budget each window; serve_bundle_lane skips forwarded ids and returns 0, so that capacity idles while other lanes' packets wait — the 'never idle' claim fails.
recommended_fix: Exclude this-tick forwarded ids from bundle_lane_ready, or donate a skip-only lane's unserved budget to the next servable lane in the window.
